schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Auto-merge devDependency minor and patch updates once CI and E2E are green. These cannot affect the shipped runtime.
Auto-merge GitHub Actions minor and patch updates. Pinned by digest via config:recommended.
Runtime dependencies ship to users and can change emulated behaviour. Always review, never auto-merge.
Major updates always need a human, regardless of dep type.
Bun itself is pinned in .tool-versions, the Dockerfile, and CI. A bump has to land in all three together, so review it.
GCP client libraries are how API fidelity is verified. A bump can legitimately surface a real incompatibility, which is a signal worth reading rather than merging past.
